verdict.rationale: Browser Use can be driven entirely from code with no interactive UI. Its documented Cloud API takes API-key-authenticated `client.runs.create(...)` calls backed by a published OpenAPI v4 spec, returns results programmatically, and lets clients poll run events. The open-source Python library is pitched for automating the web at scale from your own code, and cloud projects get documented concurrency limits. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), documented headless mode/flags for the local library, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
